The '''Ungrila''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] species in [[the galaxy]]. They had several pairs of horns above their mouths. [[Yasto Attsmun]], [[Brushaun]], and a [[Unidentified crime boss (Hradreek)|crime boss]] were members of this [[species]].

==Biology and appearances==
The Ungrila<ref name="Bounty Hunters">''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> were distinguished by the several pairs of horns that grew above their mouths. They had [[Color|black]] eyes, white hair, and brown<ref name="The Visual Dictionary" /> or white skin.<ref name="Double or Nothing" />

==History==
[[File:Brushaun-LandoDON1.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Brushaun confronts Lando Calrissian.]]
[[Brushaun]] was a member of the species who lost 2000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] in a card game on [[Canto Bight]]. Believing the man cheated, he tracked him to [[Batuv]] and confronted him.<ref name="Double or Nothing" />

In [[0 ABY]], a [[Unidentified crime boss (Hradreek)|crime boss]] of the species bought one of two [[Darth Atrius' lightsabers|lightsabers]] formally owned by the ancient [[Sith]] [[Darth Atrius]]. The [[lightsaber]] enraged him, and in his uncontrollable anger, he killed his four [[Devaronian]] thugs, dying in the process.<ref name="Annual 4">[[Star Wars Annual (2015) 4|''Star Wars Annual'' (2015) 4]]</ref>

[[Yasto Attsmun]] was a member of the species and a [[baron]]. He hosted parties aboard his [[yacht]], the ''[[Undisputed Victor]]'', on [[Cantonica]].<ref name="Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing">{{StoryCite|story=Hear Nothing, See Nothing, Say Nothing|book=Canto Bight (novella collection)}}</ref>
